title: Cottrell's tenor style and the band's saxophones
summary: Louis Cottrell was the tenor soloist with his own tone; Hall doubled baritone.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Coleman Hawkins and the great saxophonists

blocks.x: Yeah. Yesterday afternoon, I thought you. Which reminds me of something. I never had figured out where Cottrell got his tenor saxophone style. Maybe I just don't know enough about tenor saxophone.
Well, Cottrell was the tenor player in the band.

Right. See, we had the clarinet wasn't a popular instrument in those days. It was the saxophones, the altos and the tenor. And of course, Hall doubled on the baritone.
